{{samename|former World Champion|Ray Rizzo}} [[File:Rizzo.png|250px|thumb|Rizzo]] '''Rizzo''' (Japanese: '''リンゾー''' ''Rinzō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW078|Guarding the Guardian of the Mountain!]]''. He is a [[Pokémon hunter]] who wanted to capture a {{p|Volcarona}}. [[Brycen]], {{Ash}}, and {{ashfr}} attempted to interfere with his mission, but Rizzo didn't care and still went after Volcarona. He had a battle with Ash, the outcome of which would determine Volcarona's freedom. Ash sent out {{TP|Ash|Krokorok}}, which faced off against Rizzo's male Jellicent. Krokorok was able to outmatch him, but Rizzo sent out his female Jellicent. Both of the Jellicent's combined {{m|Hydro Pump}}s sent Krokorok flying into Rizzo's cage, which left Rizzo excited as he now had two Pokémon. Brycen immediately took Ash's place and battled the hunter with his Beartic. With its skills and training, Beartic was able to defeat the Jellicent, which sent them and Rizzo flying into the cage while Krokorok and Volcarona were freed. Afterwards, he was arrested by [[Officer Jenny]], who thanked Brycen for stopping Rizzo. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rizzo |pkmn=Jellicent (×2) |img=Rizzo Jellicent.png |cap=Rizzo's Jellicent |type1=Water |type2=Ghost |epnum=BW078 |epname=Guarding the Guardian of the Mountain! |vajp=Akeno Watanabe |vajpnote=Male |vajp2=Misato Fukuen |vajp2note=Female |vaen=Billy Bob Thompson |vaennote=Male |vaen2=Kayzie Rogers |vaen2note=Female |desc=Rizzo owns both a male and female {{p|Jellicent}} which were used to fight {{p|Volcarona}} and [[Ash's Krokorok]]. Both Jellicent were able to take out both Pokémon and trap them in the cage. However, [[Brycen]]'s {{p|Beartic}} was able to defeat them in the end, freeing Volcarona and Krokorok in the process and trapping both Rizzo and the Jellicent in the cage instead. Male Jellicent's known moves are {{m|Confuse Ray}}, {{m|Hydro Pump}}, and {{m|Hex}}.
